path = Path('src/mat.c')

orig = data

new = "void\nComplexFree(mat_complex_split_t* complex_data)\n{\n    if ( NULL == complex_data )\n        return;\n    free(complex_data->Re);\n    free(complex_data->Im);\n    free(complex_data);\n}\n"
if old not in data:
    raise SystemExit('ComplexFree pattern not found')
data = data.replace(old, new)

# 2) Zero-init sparse structs and complex split containers to avoid freeing indeterminate pointers

    "sparse_data    = (mat_sparse_t*)malloc(sizeof(mat_sparse_t));":
        "/* calloc so pointer members default to NULL (safe for Mat_VarFree on\n         * partial initialization/failure paths).\n         */\n        sparse_data    = (mat_sparse_t*)calloc(1,sizeof(mat_sparse_t));",

    "sparse_data->data = malloc(sizeof(mat_complex_split_t));":

    "out->internal->data = malloc(sizeof(mat_sparse_t));":

    "out->internal->data = malloc(sizeof(mat_complex_split_t));":

    "out->data = malloc(sizeof(mat_sparse_t));":

    "out->data = malloc(sizeof(mat_complex_split_t));":
        "out->data = calloc(1,sizeof(mat_complex_split_t));",
